pillars.name: Play & Creativity
pillars.description: Explore creative activities designed to spark imagination and build innovative thinking
pillars.problemsAddressed: Limited creative outlets, Screen time dependency, Lack of imaginative play
pillars.approach: Hands-on activities, Open-ended projects, Sensory exploration
pillars.whyKidsLoveIt: Fun and engaging, No right or wrong answers, Freedom to create

pillars.name: Cognitive Skills
pillars.description: Develop critical thinking, memory, and cognitive abilities through engaging activities
pillars.problemsAddressed: Short attention span, Difficulty focusing, Memory challenges

pillars.whyKidsLoveIt: Challenges feel like games, Instant gratification, Clear progress

pillars.name: Physical & Social Play

pillars.name: Language & Speech
pillars.description: Enhance communication skills and language development through interactive activities
pillars.problemsAddressed: Limited vocabulary, Shy in groups, Difficulty expressing
pillars.whyKidsLoveIt: Express themselves, Share stories, Perform and present

pillars.description: Develop fundamental learning tools and study techniques for lifelong success
pillars.problemsAddressed: Poor study habits, Disorganization, Lack of routine
